Moving RIGHT again would put the player at col 29-31. Moving RIGHT again would put the player at col 33-35. Moving RIGHT again would put the player at col 37-39. Moving RIGHT again would put the player at col 41-43. So I need to move RIGHT 6 times to reach col 41-43.
But the horizontal bar is at row 28-31, col 28-39. If the player moves RIGHT, the player would be at row 32-35, col 21-23, which doesn't overlap with the horizontal bar. So the player can move RIGHT freely.
Let me try moving RIGHT to see if the player can move past the horizontal bar.
